title: Crash when opening ShaderEditor dock with a VisualShader open
body:
### Tested versions

- Not reproducible in 4.8.dev7
- Reproducible in master

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev.mono (05d3454d2) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (2560x1440 @ 180.00 Hz, 2400x1350 @ 100.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7688) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600KF (16 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

Create a VisualShader
Switch to another dock, so that the Shader Editor dock isn't visible anymore
Switch back to the Shader Editor dock
